poses.label: Top
poses.description: Set your shoulder blades back and down, plant your feet, and hold the bar above your chest.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar toward mid-chest with your forearms stacked under it.

poses.label: Chest
poses.description: Bring the bar to mid-chest under control, keeping both feet planted.

poses.label: Press
poses.description: Press the bar up and slightly back toward the rack.

checks: Planted feet and bench support, mid-chest touch and diagonal press back toward shoulder level.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
The fixed camera and full-size plates can partially obscure the hands or bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
